_about: Hand-curated list of HSL alumni now playing at a higher level. 'key' is the player's name in lowercase as it appeared in HSL box scores (matches cache/alumni_pool.json). 'level' is one of: Pro, NCAA, U SPORTS, CHL, Junior A, Other. 'source' is a public page that confirms it. Entries without a matching pool key still show, with the HSL seasons from 'hsl' if given.

players.name: Bryce Pickford
players.note: Right-shot defenceman from Edmonton (b. 2006). Two WHL titles (Seattle 2023, Medicine Hat 2025). 2025-26: WHL Player of the Year and Top Defenceman with 45 goals, a WHL record for a defenceman since 1996. Drafted 81st overall by the Montreal Canadiens in 2025 and signed his entry-level contract Dec 2025.

players.name: Coster Dunn
players.note: Centre from Stony Plain (b. 2005). WHL champion with Seattle in 2023; 128 points in 220 WHL games. Committed to Northern Michigan University (NCAA) for 2026-27; attended Utah Mammoth camp in fall 2025.

players.name: Ethan Kronewitt
players.note: Forward from Edmonton (b. 2005). Three seasons with the Spruce Grove Saints (AJHL/BCHL), 142 games, before joining Grande Prairie for 2025-26.

players.name: Cade Meiklejohn
players.note: Forward from Leduc (b. 2005). Fort McMurray Oil Barons (AJHL) and Weyburn Red Wings (SJHL, 30 pts in 40 GP in 2023-24), then Bonnyville and Vermilion; NEAJBHL MVP and top goal scorer 2025-26.

players.name: Nate Yellowaga
players.note: Defenceman from Calgary (b. 2008). Edge School and SAHA prep, then the Brooks Bandits (AJHL/BCHL champions 2025). 27 points in 67 games as a WHL rookie with Red Deer in 2025-26; traded to Victoria in June 2026. Committed to the University of Maine.

players.name: Reily Pickford
players.note: Defenceman from Chauvin (b. 2007), Bryce's younger brother. AJHL all-star rookie with the Grande Prairie Storm in 2025-26; signed with Langley for 2026-27. WHL rights held by Medicine Hat.

players.name: Cameron Kuzma
players.note: 6'2" centre from St. Albert (b. 2008). 86 points in 30 games with Eagles U14 in 2021-22; Notre Dame Hounds U18 AAA; drafted 61st overall by Regina in the 2023 WHL Prospects Draft and signed at 14. Traded to Red Deer in 2025-26 (21 points in 34 games). Committed to Lake Superior State (NCAA) for 2027.

players.name: Landon DuPont
players.note: Right-shot defenceman from Calgary (b. 2009). First overall in the 2024 WHL draft and only the second player ever granted exceptional status to play at 15; first rookie defenceman to 50 points since Scott Niedermayer. 73 points in 63 games for Everett in 2025-26, WHL champions and Memorial Cup. Committed to Michigan for 2026-27; eligible for the 2027 NHL Draft.

players.name: Ossie McIntyre
players.note: Forward from St. Albert (b. 2009). Swept the AEHL U15 scoring titles in 2023-24, then went 7th overall to Spokane in the 2024 WHL Prospects Draft. 44 games with the Chiefs in 2025-26; eligible for the 2027 NHL Draft.

players.name: Jordin St. Louis
players.note: Forward (b. 2009). Portland Winterhawks (WHL) prospect; played two games for Portland in 2025-26 before being reassigned to Olds, where he had 22 points in his first 29 AJHL games.

players.name: Antonio Martorana
players.note: Right winger from Edmonton (b. 2007). Seattle Thunderbirds (WHL) commitment in 2022, then Quebec prep hockey (Bourget Collège, playoff MVP and champion 2024-25) before joining the Bears in the Central Canada Hockey League.

players.name: Adam Halat
players.note: Forward from Chestermere (b. 2009). Led the Alberta U18 AAA league in scoring as a 15-year-old with Okotoks (40 points in 23 games). Drafted 72nd overall by Calgary in 2024 and traded to Saskatoon.

players.name: Samuel Charko
players.note: Forward (b. 2007). Drafted by Seattle in 2022; two seasons with the Thunderbirds, then the Vernon Vipers (BCHL) before the Giants added him for the rest of 2025-26.

players.name: Simon Lovsin
players.note: Forward (b. 2006). Second-round WHL pick (44th overall, 2021) out of Saints Pro; HSL U17 champion in 2021-22. 35 points in 64 games in 2024-25 and 32 in 2025-26; ranked by McKeen's for the 2024 NHL Draft.

players.name: Luke Ruptash
players.note: Power forward from St. Albert (b. 2009). 57 points in 29 games with the St. Albert U15 AAA Sabres, then 16th overall to Medicine Hat in the 2024 WHL Prospects Draft.

players.name: Mirco Dufour
players.note: Centre from Rocky View (b. 2009). 19th overall to Everett in the 2024 WHL draft; gold with Canada Red at the 2025 U17 World Challenge and a WHL title with Everett in 2025-26.

players.name: Cole Kronewitt
players.note: Forward from Stony Plain (b. 2007), Ethan's younger brother. Came up through Saints Pro in the HSL, then 39 points in 33 games with Titans Hockey Union 18U before signing with the Saints for 2024-25.
